<section_guide number="8" title="Open Questions">
<purpose>Keep unverified assumptions and unresolved product choices visible without treating them as confirmed requirements.</purpose>

<questions>
1. Which beliefs in the current document still need user evidence?
2. Which unresolved decisions would block creating or evaluating the PoC?
</questions>

<workflow>
Review the full document for assumptions, alternatives that remain open, and missing product
decisions. Record nonessential edge cases here when they should be revisited after the ideal-path
PoC. Do not repeat confirmed requirements. For each assumption, state the evidence that would
confirm or challenge it. If no decision blocks the PoC, record "None" in 8.3.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm that every unresolved item is separated from confirmed product content before saving.</completion>
</section_guide>
